messages:
sam: Quick onboarding check for orion-65b weights + tokenizer before we cut the dedicated job. Weights in s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/ — asking about max context, kv cache format, and OOM risk for 4k+ batches. /cc @rachel @lee

rachel: I pulled the weights yesterday. weights_path: s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/weights.pt. config.json shows max_position_embeddings: 8192. tokenizer.json uses a custom byte-level BPE with reserved tokens <s>,</s> - there are duplicate special tokens right now.

lee: duplicate special tokens = tokenizer.train_files include both '<s>' and '</s>' twice? can you paste snippet?

rachel: paste config snippet: ```json
{"model": {"max_position_embeddings": 8192, "hidden_size": 12288}, "tokenizer": {"special_tokens": ["<s>","</s>","<pad>","<s>"]}}```

sam: that duplicate <s> is dangerous. rachel can you run tokenizer.normalize_special_tokens() or remove dup before export?

rachel: yes I'll patch and upload new tokenizer.json. Also kv cache format in weights metadata says 'kv_format': 'v1-raw' which our runtime doesn't like for long context. Should convert to 'v2-compact'

lee: v1-raw uses contiguous KV per layer -> big mem. v2-compact interleaves and reduces factor ~1.8. conversion script at tools/kv_convert.py — run: ```python tools/kv_convert.py --in s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/kv.raw --out s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/kv.v2 --layers 64``` 

sam: good. what's the expected peak GPU mem for 8192 ctx with batch_size=1? need to warn infra.

rachel: rough calc: model params ~66B -> ~132GB fp16, plus kv ~ layers*seq_len*head_dim*2 bytes. For 8192 it's ~60-80GB extra. With sharding we'll need >300GB GPU host or use 4k maxctx.

lee: recommend target maxctx for Dedicated = 4096 for now. Also enable prefix KV caching and offload to host using --kv-host-offload in runtime. There is PR 4387 to add kv-host-offload support; @sam can you review?

sam: on it. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4387

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for staging at 2024-11-02T18:00Z if PR merged.

rachel: I'll upload corrected tokenizer and converted kv this afternoon and annotate sizes.

lee: also validate config: ensure model.config['max_position_embeddings'] >= tokenizer.max_len. CI check in tools/validate_model.py will fail otherwise. Run: ```python tools/validate_model.py --path s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/``` 

sam: timeline: upload done today, PR review EOD, staging deploy tomorrow. @lee will monitor OOM in staging.

lee: noted. if OOM, fallback plan is to launch as 4k shards + quantized weights q4_0 to reduce mem.

rachel: uploaded ✅ s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/tokenizer.json (v2) and s3://redwood-models/orion-65b/v1/kv.v2. sizes: tokenizer 450KB, kv.v2 38GB. I'll post a short manifest shortly.

sam: thanks all. ping me when uploads complete.
